status-word.purpose: Off, Starting, Online, Shutting down, Unknown on the status card. The loudest text on the dashboard.

title.purpose: Every card title; 15px in the Settings popover.

wordmark.purpose: "Beacon" beside the pixel app mark; 20px on sign-in.

address.purpose: The join address, tabular, never broken mid-number; 18px on phones.

body.purpose: All running text, rows, values, toasts. Big counts step up to 20px semibold.

label.purpose: Field labels, row details, footnotes, in Faint.

themes.light: daytime: applies under prefers-color-scheme: light unless data-theme="dark", or when data-theme="light" on <html>; the day-* colour tokens are its values for the same CSS variables
themes.persistence: localStorage beacon-theme; follows the system until the visitor picks a theme

settings.name: bands
settings.effect: hides every card band; cards must read fully without them

assignments.status: stone (off, stopping, unknown) / torch (booting, loading) / grass (online)

shadows.name: slab
shadows.purpose: Every card, popover, toast and dialog.

shadows.name: slab-lifted
shadows.purpose: Dashboard cards under a hovering pointer, with translate(-1px, -1px).

shadows.name: band-seam
shadows.purpose: The darker underside of a material band.

motion.name: ease-lift
motion.purpose: Card lift (160ms), Online dot pulse (1.8s), pixel burst (1000ms).

motion.name: sleepy
motion.purpose: Current boot block and beacon core while off or stopping.

motion.name: bob
motion.purpose: Current boot block while booting or loading.

motion.name: beam-pulse
motion.purpose: The beacon beam and sparks when online.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animation and transition durations 0.01ms, one iteration; pixel burst not rendered

narrative.overview:
Beacon is a server dashboard that feels like a menu inside the game it controls: warm, tactile, built from blocks, instead of a terminal. It refuses both the near-black ops console it replaced and the cartoon kids' launcher. The material is chunky and physical: stone-slab cards with an ink outline and a small hard shadow, buttons that sink when pressed, a thin strip of grass, sky, dirt or stone on top of every card, and crisp pixel-art drawn on whole-pixel grids. The tone is friendly and a little playful but grown-up; it is never a kids' play site.

Density is calm and readable: one column on phones, a wide main column plus a 360px rail on desktop, 24px between cards. Everything a person reads or counts is set in a plain, sturdy sans (Public Sans) with tabular numerals; the pixel face (Pixelify Sans) is reserved for names, the things you would see on a game menu's tabs. One accent, beacon cyan, carries the primary action, focus, selection and the beacon's own light. Twilight (dark, warm plum) is the default; daytime (sky-blue ground, white cards, the same ink outlines) follows the system until the visitor picks a theme, and both meet WCAG AA.

Confirmed rejections: no mascot faces, no jokes in sign-in, power confirmations or errors, no Mojang logos, textures, fonts or screenshots, and no near-black terminal look.
keyCharacteristics: Stone-slab cards: 2px ink outline, 10px corners, 4px hard offset shadow, a 6px material band on top.
One accent (beacon cyan) and one primary button per state.
Pixelify Sans for names only; Public Sans with tabular numerals for everything read or counted.
Pixel art as inline SVG on small integer grids, rendered crisp (`image-rendering: pixelated`).
Warm twilight dark by default, daytime light on request; both AA, 44px touch targets.
One motion grammar: short ease-out, transform and opacity only, off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Beacon Rule
rules.body: Beacon cyan marks the primary action, focus, selection and the beacon's light, and nothing else. A screen shows at most one cyan button at a time: Start server while off, Copy while online.

rules.name: The Materials Stay Thin Rule
rules.body: Grass, sky, dirt, stone and torch appear only as card bands, the header ground line, the boot-track blocks, avatars and meter segments. They never fill a card, a button or a page area.

rules.name: The Not By Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state carries a word plus a mark or shape: the status word beside its dot, pills with a square mark and text, unfilled boot blocks drawn as dashed outlines rather than dimmed fills.

rules.name: The Pixel Names Rule
rules.body: Pixelify Sans appears only on the wordmark, page and dialog titles, card titles and the status word. Never on body copy, buttons, labels, numbers or the join address.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every number that updates or is compared (address, players, sizes, times, costs, countdowns) uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Hard Light Rule
rules.body: Shadows are solid Obsidian offsets with zero blur. Nothing glows, nothing floats on a soft shadow.

rules.name: The Press Sink Rule
rules.body: Buttons sit on a 3px key shadow and sink into it when pressed; a disabled button is already sunk.

dos: **Do** build every new card (Discord alerts, whitelist, anything else) as a Slab panel with a 2px Edge outline, 10px corners, a material band and a Pixelify card title in the 24px/20px header row.
**Do** pick a band by what the card is about: grass for live or online, sky for people, dirt for the world and its files, stone for operations, logs and costs, torch only for starting.
**Do** keep exactly one Beacon Cyan button visible per state; everything else is secondary, danger or ghost.
**Do** set every number in Public Sans with tabular numerals, including the join address.
**Do** make every tappable thing at least 44px, show the 3px focus ring, and keep text AA and controls 3:1 in both twilight and daytime.
**Do** pair every state colour with a word and a mark or shape.
**Do** draw pixel art as inline SVG on an integer grid with Obsidian outlines, sized in whole multiples, coloured only from theme tokens.
**Do** keep a card fully readable with bands switched off.
donts: **Don't** use Pixelify Sans for body copy, buttons, labels, numbers or the join address.
**Don't** add a second accent colour, or use Beacon Cyan for decoration, headings or status.
**Don't** fill cards, buttons or page areas with material colours; materials stay in bands, blocks, avatars and meters.
**Don't** use blurred, glowing or ambient shadows; depth is a hard Obsidian offset.
**Don't** draw mascot faces or characters; avatars are symmetric patterns.
**Don't** put jokes or playful lines in sign-in, power confirmations or errors; the friendly lines live beside the status word, which itself stays plain.
**Don't** use Mojang logos, textures, fonts or screenshots, or images from another origin.
**Don't** return to the near-black terminal look.
**Don't** add motion outside the status card's loops and the shared enter, lift and press transitions, or any motion that survives reduced-motion.
